description: This file defines the public API for temperature-related functions within the Manufacturer Library (MFR) HAL, including temperature state enumeration, functions to get current temperatures, set and get temperature thresholds, and clock speed management.

methods.name: mfrGetTemperature
methods.description: Retrieves the current platform temperature states and raw temperature values for core and Wi-Fi chips.

methods.name: mfrSetTempThresholds
methods.description: Sets the high and critical temperature thresholds in non-volatile storage.

methods.name: mfrGetTempThresholds
methods.description: Retrieves the stored high and critical temperature thresholds.

methods.name: mfrDetermineClockSpeeds
methods.description: Determines appropriate CPU clock speeds for different operational states.

methods.name: mfrSetClockSpeed
methods.description: Sets the CPU clock speed to a specified value.

methods.name: mfrGetClockSpeed
methods.description: Retrieves the current CPU clock speed.

ctags.name: mfrTEMPERATURE_CRITICAL
ctags.pattern: /^    mfrTEMPERATURE_CRITICAL,    \/\/\/< Temp is critical, should trigger a thermal reset. $/

ctags.name: mfrTEMPERATURE_HIGH
ctags.pattern: /^    mfrTEMPERATURE_HIGH,        \/\/\/< Temp is high, but just a warning as device can still ope/

ctags.name: mfrTEMPERATURE_MAX
ctags.pattern: /^    mfrTEMPERATURE_MAX          \/\/\/< Out of range - required to be the last item of the enum.$/

ctags.name: mfrTEMPERATURE_NORMAL
ctags.pattern: /^    mfrTEMPERATURE_NORMAL = 0,  \/\/\/< Temp is within normal operating range. $/
